text:
Noah: Putting together a compact solution brief for the fintech play — secure inference + SLAs + routing to private deployments. Want the one-pager to be very skimmable for account teams. Figma link: https://redwood.app/figma/finserv-brief

Priya: Include a 2-line customer outcome at the top and a single metric highlight: p95 latency + cost delta. Also list compliance certs.

Zoe: Bench notes: text-gen-2 on Dedicated @ 512 tokens p95 = 70ms; median cost per 1k tokens = $0.44. We measured self-host baseline from customer signals at $0.72/k. We'll claim ~39% lower unit cost. I'll drop CSV in drive.

Noah: For the launch, propose a short webinar (Apr 12) targeted at platform and security leads. Demo planned: routing + KMS setup + audit log walkthrough. Zoe, can you provide the bench slide? Priya, can you write the short customer-facing blurb?

Priya: On it. Also let's run an A/B subject line for webinar invites: "Secure LLM Serving for FinTech" vs "SLAs & Cost Savings for Regulated Apps". Track open and registration.

CampaignBot: Landing page scaffold ready: https://redwood.app/landing/finserv-inference. I can auto-inject UTM tags and track conversions. Schedule suggested Apr 12 11:00 PT if assets ready by Apr 8 EOD.

Noah: Great. Delivery checklist: Noah = one-pager design + flowchart; Priya = copy + webinar invite; Zoe = bench slide + raw data; CampaignBot = landing + tracking. Let's keep the one-pager filename succinct for field: finserv-brief.pdf."
